name: npm-pack-nested-gitignore
description: npm pack excludes paths via a NESTED .gitignore (e.g. src/ui/.gitignore dist/) even when the files array lists them; only root .gitignore rules are overridable by files. Fix: move the ignore rule to the root .gitignore. warren-402e

name: install-script-conventions
description: scripts/install.sh is the curl|sh installer for @os-eco/warren-cli: bun bootstrap to ~/.bun (no sudo), npm-global preferred with bun add -g fallback when the npm prefix is root-owned, WARREN_INSTALL_VERSION/WARREN_INSTALL_TARBALL env knobs, PATH guidance printed against the ORIGINAL_PATH captured at script start (prepending to PATH early otherwise suppresses the guidance). CI smoke in install-smoke.yml runs the script in clean ubuntu:24.04 and node:20-slim containers against a locally packed tarball; it has no bun-run steps so check:ci-parity is unaffected.
